original_findings_addressed.source_change: An eager Layout computes its column count from its finite proposed content width plus the component canvas inset, and ordinary native text category. It measures each card at its column width and places rows at their maximum measured height; RTL placement follows native direction. No asynchronous width state is required on iOS 16/macOS 13 and later. Deployment targets stay unchanged, with explicit width callbacks for older systems.
